title: How to calculate overtime pay
task: Split hours into regular and overtime at 1.5x past 40 — payroll's most common formula.

excel.note: A2=total hours, B2=hourly rate. Change 40 and 1.5 to your rules.

explanation: MIN caps the regular hours at 40 and MAX floors the overtime at zero, so the pair works for both sides of the threshold: 45 hours at $20 is 40×20 + 5×30 = $950, and a 35-hour week is simply 35×20 with no negative overtime. The same MIN/MAX pattern handles any tiered rate — double time past 60 just adds another MAX term.
